blurb: WCMAA was founded under the late Sifu Bruce Lee and living legend Guro Dan Inosanto. Guro/Sifu Marvin Ishmael is a 2nd generation instructor in Jeet Kune Do under Sifu Bruce by way of Sifu Dan Inosanto, and a 1st generation instructor in Filipino Kali and Silat under Guro Inosanto. The combination of Martial Arts offered is highly effective in dealing with opponents in the quickest way possible.
